Verified GET /api/settings/public returns new CMS fields (contact_heading, contact_whatsapp=919148271005, contact_phone/email/address, policies_intro, hours[], policies[]). Verified PUT /api/admin/settings is owner-only (admin → 403) and persists contact block, hours list, policies list + policies_intro; every persisted value is retrievable via /settings/public. Frontend: verified Landing.js renders WhatsApp CTA data-testid='whatsapp-link' → https://wa.me/919148271005 and QR image data-testid='whatsapp-qr' with matching URL, plus hours strip from site.hours. /policies renders CMS policies (Reservation window, Group threshold, …) and policies_intro. All backend & UI checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsInput uses Optional[List[dict]] for hours/policies (untyped dict). Consider Pydantic sub-models (HoursEntry{days,time,note}, PolicyEntry{title,body}) to validate shape at the API boundary instead of trusting client payloads.
QR is served by third-party api.qrserver.com. If offline/blocked, image will 404. Consider serving a locally-generated QR (e.g., qrcode lib) as a fallback or using an swap.
contact_whatsapp input strips non-digits — good, but there is no length/E.164 validation; entering '1' will still be accepted and produce a bad wa.me link. Add min-length or regex.

get_settings() self-heals defaults, but new CMS fields only backfill on read; a settings doc created before the CMS change may already exist with missing keys — verified this path works via /settings/public. Consider a one-time migration for cleanliness.
PoliciesPage relies on /settings/public keys existing; if a future PUT accidentally sets policies=[] the page will render empty. Consider falling back to defaults when list is empty.
server.py is now ~1080+ lines — splitting into routers (auth/reservations/menu/events/cms) still recommended (carried over from iter 10).
